rooted for your home.
settings.copy: We're a working nursery, not a big-box greenhouse. Every plant we sell was propagated, hardened off, and hand-selected on our own beds — so it's already adapted to your climate before it ever reaches your porch.

settings.title: Four honest steps,
settings.intro: Here's exactly how a plant gets from Fern & Clay to your home — and why it's stronger for the journey.

steps.title: Propagate on-site
steps.text: We start everything ourselves — from seed, cutting, or division — in our own propagation house, so we know each plant's history from day one.

steps.title: Harden off slowly
steps.text: Plants are gradually introduced to sun, wind, and temperature swings over weeks, building the resilience they need to thrive in a real garden.

steps.title: Hand-select & pot
steps.text: Our growers walk the beds and choose only the strongest, best-shaped plants. Anything weak or leggy never makes it to the sales floor.

steps.title: Send you home with care
steps.text: Every plant leaves with a care card written for your specific zone — watering, light, and when to repot. No guesswork, no mystery.

settings.note: Fern & Clay is built on honesty: bring in a photo of a struggling plant and we'll tell you what's wrong — even if the fix means buying nothing from us.

settings.title: Plants that
settings.intro: Most plants die in the first month because they were grown in a perfect greenhouse and shipped across the country. Ours are different — here's what that means for you.

features.title: Grown for your climate
features.text: We propagate and harden off every plant in your local conditions, so it's already adapted to your sun, wind, and seasons before you take it home.

features.title: No shipping shock
features.text: Our plants never sit in a dark truck for days. They go from our beds to your garden in hours, arriving strong and ready to establish.

features.title: Hand-selected, every one
features.text: Growers walk the beds and choose only the strongest specimens. Weak, leggy, or pest-stressed plants are composted, never sold.

features.title: Real soil, real roots
features.text: We grow in a rich, living mix that builds strong root systems — not the sterile peat plugs that strangle plants after transplant.

features.title: Care advice that's honest
features.text: Every plant leaves with a zone-specific care card, and our growers answer questions for free — even if the answer is 'this one won't work in your spot.'

features.title: Built to come back
features.text: Perennials, natives, and hardy annuals chosen to return year after year — so your garden grows with you, not against you.
